import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def fetch_arxiv_page(start_idx):
    # Encode spaces as %20 manually to avoid control‑character errors
    query = 'all:multimodal%20OR%20all:RAG'
    url = f'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start={start_idx}&max_results=25&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
    return web_fetch(url=url)

# XML namespace used by arXiv RSS feeds
NS = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}

def is_multimodal_relevant(title, summary):
    """Simple relevance filter for multimodal / vision‑language RAG papers."""
    text = (title + ' ' + summary).lower()
    keywords = [
        'multimodal', 'vision', 'visual', 'image', 'video', 'audio',
        'speech', 'crossmodal', 'cross-modal', 'vlm', 'vision-language',
        'vision language', 'graph', 'document', 'table', 'chart',
        'figure', 'illustration', 'embedding', 'alignment', 'fusion'
    ]
    return any(k in text for k in keywords)

papers = []          # collected paper dicts
start = 0            # API start index (each page = 25 results)
max_pages = 10       # safety ceiling

while len(papers) < 5 and start < max_pages * 25:
    resp = fetch_arxiv_page(start)
    if resp.get('status') != 200:
        print(f'Failed to fetch page starting at {start}')
        break
    
    root = ET.fromstring(resp['content'])
    for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', NS):
        title_el = entry.find('atom:title', NS)
        summary_el = entry.find('atom:summary', NS)
        updated_el = entry.find('atom:updated', NS)
        id_el = entry.find('atom:id', NS)
        link_el = None
        for l in entry.findall('atom:link', NS):
            if l.get('rel') == 'alternate' and l.get('type') == 'text/html':
                link_el = l.get('href')
                break
        
        if None in (title_el, summary_el, updated_el, id_el):
            continue
        
        title = title_el.text.strip()
        summary = ' '.join(summary_el.text.strip().split())
        updated = updated_el.text.strip()[:10]   # just the date part
        arxiv_id = id_el.text.strip()
        
        # Relevance filter
        if not is_multimodal_relevant(title, summary):
            continue
        
        papers.append({
            'title'   : title,
            'summary' : summary,
            'date'    : updated,
            'link'    : link_el,
            'arxiv_id': arxiv_id
        })
        if len(papers) >= 5:
            break
    
    start += 25   # move to the next page

# ---------- Build markdown comparison table ----------
def build_markdown(papers):
    header = "| Rank | Title | Date | Summary (≤150 chars) | Link |\n"
    separator = "|------|-------|------|----------------------|------|\n"
    rows = []
    for i, p in enumerate(papers[:5], 1):
        short_sum = ' '.join(p['summary'].split()[:10])  # crude ≤150‑char truncation
        short_sum = short_sum[:150].replace('\n', ' ')
        rows.append(f"| {i} | {p['title']} | {p['date']} | {short_sum} | [{p['link']}]({p['link']}) |")
    return header + separator + "\n".join(rows)

md_content = build_markdown(papers)

# Write the markdown file
with open('papers.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(md_content)

print(f'Collected {len(papers)} multimodal RAG papers and wrote a comparison table to papers.md')
